description: This PHP class 'HolidayDecorator' in the 'OrangeHRM' project serves as a decorator for the 'Holiday' entity, adding presentation or formatting functionalities such as formatting the holiday date and interpreting holiday length names.

classes.name: HolidayDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Holiday entity that provides formatted date and length name representations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a Holiday object.

methods.name: getHoliday
methods.description: Protected method to access the encapsulated Holiday object.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of the holiday.

methods.name: getLengthName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name for the holiday length, or null if unavailable.
